FAQ.title: Got Questions? We Have Answers
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting your learning journey.
FAQ.a1: Webind Edu is designed for SMP/SMA students and university beginners who want to learn computer science, programming, and AI through personalized 1-on-1 sessions.
FAQ.q2: Do I need prior programming experience?
FAQ.a2: Not at all! We have programs starting from absolute zero (Digital Starter) up to advanced AI development. We'll assess your level and create a personalized learning path.
FAQ.a3: Sessions are conducted online via Google Meet or Zoom, 90 minutes each. You'll work directly with your tutor on hands-on exercises and projects.
FAQ.q4: What will I have after completing a program?
FAQ.a4: You'll have real projects for your portfolio, a certificate of completion, and practical skills you can immediately apply.
FAQ.q5: Can parents monitor their child's progress?
FAQ.a5: Yes! We provide regular progress reports covering attendance, skill development, assignment completion, and tutor notes.
